note: The typical edition prints no Alleluia with this chant on this feast. The digital common carries a Paschaltide Alleluia in parentheses, declared in its witness as a recension. The remaining spelling and punctuation differences are recorded below.

adjudicated.ruling: The pinned digital source uses consonantal j; the typical edition prints i (p. 572), and the edition follows it (ORTHOGRAPHY rule 2).
